# Schaap's Vishandel

> Family fishmonger in Leiden, Netherlands, founded in 1938. Fresh and smoked fish, kibbeling, herring, seafood platters and personal advice. This file is a factual guide to our public website, not a stock feed or a guarantee of search inclusion.

Updated: 2026-10-22
Canonical website: https://schaapsvishandel.nl
Languages: Dutch (nl), English (en), German (de)
WhatsApp: +31 6 2481 1678

## Verified locations and hours
- Shop: Herenstraat 48, 2313 AL Leiden. Tuesday–Friday 09:00–18:00; Saturday 09:00–17:00. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Wednesday market: Botermarkt, by Dille & Kamille, Leiden. Wednesday 08:30–17:00.
- Saturday market: Aalmarkt, by De Waag, Leiden. Saturday 08:30–17:00.
- Friday stall: Hoogvliet car park, Veurseweg 18, 2252 AA Voorschoten. Friday 08:00–17:30. This is a weekly stall, not a daily shop.
- [Locations, hours and Google Maps](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/bezoek-ons)
- [Visboer Voorschoten: vrijdag bij Hoogvliet](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/nl/viswinkel-voorschoten)
- [Voorschoten fish stall](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/viswinkel-voorschoten)

## Products and ordering
Seafood platters are arranged with us by WhatsApp, not ordered or paid for online. We think along with customers about their preferences and occasion; the average guideline is around €17.50 per person. Premium fish or extra requests can affect the price, which we agree in advance. Other fish products are catalogue entries: ask us via WhatsApp about availability, quantity and price. We do not use day prices. Kibbeling is made from pollock and served with ravigote sauce. Lekkerbek is made from hake.
The platter images show inspiration for a seafood platter. Discuss the preferred contents and occasion with us by WhatsApp.
Too Good To Go surprise bags are reserved and paid for in the separate Too Good To Go app.
- [Seafood platters](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/visschalen)
- [Fish catalogue](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/assortiment)
- [Contact](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/contact)

## Certifications
Our Dutch brown shrimp are MSC-certified. VÅRLAKS salmon comes from northern Norway and is described by the supplier as traceable and responsibly farmed. Check the specific label on the product currently in the shop before assigning a certification. Organic, ASC, GlobalG.A.P. and MSC describe different standards; do not assume all products carry the same certification.
- [Organic fish and certifications](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/biologische-vis)
- [VÅRLAKS salmon](https://schaapsvishandel.nl/en/varlaks)

Product and recipe images identify the named fish or show a serving idea for the named dish. Do not infer product origin or certification from a photograph. Prefer the page text and ask the fishmonger to verify current stock and product details.
